subject: Budget validation: monthly spend band & procurement thresholds
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up + budget validation (token volumes / procurement)

Hi Samira — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery and three asks so we can finalize a scoped pricing estimate: 

1) Expected monthly token volume bands (best guess): e.g., 100M-200M, 200M-500M, 500M-1B. If you can indicate which band feels right it helps sharpen the unit economics.

2) Procurement thresholds / PO requirements: is there a minimum monthly or annual contract value procurement will require (e.g., $50k/mo or $600k/yr)? Also let us know whether you need an SOW or standard MSA before a PO.

3) Target $/1M tokens (if you have an internal target). If not, we can propose a few bands tied to commit levels.

We can send a one-sheet with three pricing bands and recommended routing (hosted vs. dedicated) plus procurement notes. Attaching a short usage template — fill the columns you know and send back.

Next steps: if you can reply with the band and procurement constraints by EOD Wed, we’ll return a pricing sheet + sample contract language by Thu.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172
redwood.ai
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmepayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + budget validation (token volumes / procurement)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the template — useful. A few data points from our side: 

- Expected steady-state volume: we think we’ll fall into the 200M-500M tokens/mo band in Q2 once the pilots scale. Peak could approach 700M in promotional weeks.
- Procurement thresholds: procurement wants a minimum contractual value of $50k/month to approve a standing PO without higher-level legal review. Anything above $200k/month will trigger additional security & legal cycles and an executive approval.
- Target unit economics: the finance team is expecting something around $1,000–$1,500 per 1M tokens as a target to make the project IRR-friendly. If you have model-specific lanes (e.g., smaller cheaper model for background tasks, larger for user-facing), please call that out.

We do need the pricing and procurement language for our procurement team to review. Could you also confirm billing cadence options (monthly vs. quarterly invoicing) and any minimum commitment term?

Best,
Samira

Samira Khan
Head of Product Operations, Acme Payments
samira.khan@acmepayments.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Acme — budget bands & procurement thresholds (need pricing bands)

Looping you both — Acme confirmed 200M-500M/mo with peaks ~700M. Procurement gating: $50k/mo threshold for standard PO; >$200k/mo requires exec/legal. Finance target $1k–$1.5k per 1M tokens.

Can we: 
- Draft 3 pricing bands corresponding to 200–500M, 500–800M, and 800M–1.5B with committed and overage tiers. Include model routing suggestion: hosted mid-tier for inference and optional dedicated capacity if >800M sustained.
- Call out billing cadence (monthly invoiced, net-30 standard; quarterly available for commit deals), and minimum term options (monthly rolling vs. 12/24-month commit with discounts).
- Confirm whether we can meet the procurement threshold sensitivity: if they sign a 12-month commit at $50k/mo, procurement is happy. If it’s month-to-month and hits >$200k in any month, expect extra review.

Attaching a draft pricing workbook. Please add unit economics rows: cost to serve per 1M tokens (approx), proposed list price per 1M, and margin. I’ll include the final sheet in reply to Samira.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme — budget bands & procurement thresholds (pricing proposal)

Thanks Marissa — I updated the pricing workbook and added a recommended band table. Summary: 

- Band A (200–500M/mo): Suggested list price $1,400 per 1M tokens; committed 6-month min at $50k/mo gets to ~$1,200 per 1M. Overage at $1,600 per 1M. Hosted API recommended.
- Band B (500–800M/mo): Suggested list price $1,200 per 1M tokens; 12-month commit at $120k/mo reduces to ~$950 per 1M. Recommend hybrid routing (hosted for spiky, dedicated for sustained).
- Band C (800M–1.5B/mo): Dedicated capacity recommended. With a 12–24 month commit and guaranteed minimum of $200k/mo we can hit ~$700–$850 per 1M tokens depending on caching and quantization profile.

Procurement notes: we can support monthly invoicing net-30. For PO threshold: $50k/mo is fine for a standard PO. Anything that would average >$200k/mo should be transitioned to an enterprise contract (longer review).

Attached: redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx (contains unit economics rows, assumptions, and sample amortized infra cost per 1M tokens). Also attached the usage snapshot Acme provided for transparency.

If you want, I can draft two short contract language snippets: (A) 12-month commit agreement language for procurement, and (B) month-to-month TOS with overage billing.

-Neha

Neha Kapoor
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
